profile: BF16 storage/output, FP32 accumulation, no TF32/FP16/fast-math fallback

decisions.operations: Single-stream DiT, metadata, block-causal mask, prefix K/V
decisions.transfer: Native C port of model equations; immutable request-owned inputs, detached prefix-only K/V, resource groups and lifecycle use DS4 contracts.
decisions.hypothesis: Preserving BF16 boundaries, complex FMA order, segment GEMM geometry and PV layout reproduces the pinned native-library oracle.
decisions.rejected: Real-arithmetic RoPE, libc-generated frequencies, flattened head GEMM and transposed PV change BF16 ties. Target-only final projection in the full first step also changed geometry. Failed runs remain preserved.

decisions.operations: FP32 math SDPA with BF16 input/output and wide VAE heads
decisions.transfer: Head-contiguous strided-batched SGEMM, split Q/K scale, explicit softmax bounds and 256-query tiles. Score storage is linear in key count. CPU reference uses independent loops.
decisions.hypothesis: Actual image-model GEMM geometry matches the oracle with bounded score scratch.
decisions.limitation: Correctness baseline, no FlashAttention throughput claim. Quantized LLM GEMV and MoE expert scheduling do not directly transfer to dense image GEMM.

decisions.transfer: Official fixed sigma grid and scalar-promotion BF16 boundaries; independent version-1 SplitMix64/Box-Muller generator. Oracle parity uses explicit noise.
decisions.rejected: An early development oracle initialized the sample as FP32 and dumped BF16 latent payloads under the wrong type. oracle-v2 corrects those fixtures; T00 tolerances remain unchanged.
decisions.cache_comparison: Same latent is supplied to cached/full forwards at each step. Independent Euler trajectories are retained separately as diagnostics; full-sequence versus target-only GEMM rounding accumulates in reversed and exceeds the final relative ceiling.

decisions.operations: Qwen 2.1 VAE image encode/decode and tiling
decisions.transfer: First-frame temporal shortcuts, 64-channel normalization, deterministic native cuDNN image descriptors, full low-resolution attention and local upsampling tiles with explicit halo/overlap.
decisions.hypothesis: Keeping global attention outside local decoder tiles preserves alpha and edge gates while bounding high-resolution activations.
decisions.rejected: Assuming temporal shortcut factors equal one, generic small-head attention, reciprocal-multiply L2 normalization and singleton-time 3D convolution geometry did not reproduce the image oracle.

decisions.transfer: Reuse C codec with incremental CRC and checked allocation/write/close. Host result owns no GPU buffer or model. No new codec dependency.
